answer.worked:
For the sketch, find the intercepts:
$$\begin{align*}y&=3(0)+6=6\\0&=3x+6\\x&=-2\end{align*}$$
Draw the line through $(0,6)$ and $(-2,0)$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta&=3\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}(3)\\\theta&\approx72^\circ\end{align*}$$

For the sketch, find the intercepts:
$$\begin{align*}y&=-\tfrac12(0)+1=1\\0&=-\tfrac12x+1\\x&=2\end{align*}$$
Draw the line through $(0,1)$ and $(2,0)$. The inverse tangent is negative, so add $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta&=-\tfrac12\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}(-\tfrac12)+180^\circ\\\theta&\approx153^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}4y&=-3x-12\\y&=-\tfrac34x-3\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}y&=-\tfrac34(0)-3=-3\\0&=-\tfrac34x-3\\x&=-4\end{align*}$$
Draw the line through $(0,-3)$ and $(-4,0)$. The inverse tangent is negative, so add $180^\circ$.
